suppress.notes: Not using Spring Boot Cassandra SSL auto-configuration.
DevTools remote secret endpoint is not enabled in production deployments.
ApplicationTemp hardening applies when devtools/temp features are used.
RandomValuePropertySource is not used for security-sensitive secrets in this service.
PID file writer is not used in containerized deployments.
Spring Security 6.4.13 is latest 6.4.x on Maven Central; vendor advisory lists fix in unpublished 6.4.15. Standard Spring Security filter chain; no custom BypassPaths.
Same as CVE-2026-22732 — awaiting spring-security-bom > 6.4.13 on Maven Central.
JSON REST API only; not using Spring MVC resource handler cache poisoning patterns.
Annotation detection DoS mitigated by standard request size limits and WAF in production.
STOMP/WebSocket broker not used for external-facing messaging in this deployment model.
No spring-boot-starter-actuator on classpath; CVE-2026-22731 requires Actuator Health Group additional-path. OSS fix is Boot 3.5.12+ / commercial 3.4.15 — not applicable until upgrade.
HTTP/3 (netty-codec-http3) not used; Netty 4.1.134.Final includes 4.1.133 security backports per Netty advisory. OWASP CPE range incorrectly flags 4.1.x (see netty-4.1.133.Final release notes).
False positive on angus-activation; angus-mail is overridden to 2.0.5 in pom (fix in smtp >= 2.0.4).
